#####  Project General Facts

Maison Cannelle Residence by Casa Moderna reimagines contemporary luxury in the heart of Al Furjan, one of Dubai's most sought-after residential communities. This iconic development introduces a collection of private residences designed for elegant city living infused with tranquility and sophistication. Each home reflects a refined architectural vision, balancing sleek minimalism with natural harmony through expansive glass façades, smooth contours, and warm tones that maximize light and outdoor integration.

Residents enjoy an elevated lifestyle enhanced by thoughtfully curated amenities. The development features a stunning rooftop swimming pool, offering the perfect setting for relaxation and leisure. Every residence is designed as a fully automated smart home, providing seamless control over lighting, climate, and security, all at residents' fingertips for a smarter, more comfortable lifestyle. Complemented by 24/7 security, covered parking, and a peaceful neighborhood atmosphere, Maison Cannelle delivers the perfect balance between community living and urban convenience.

The interiors emphasize sophisticated comfort, featuring high ceilings, open layouts, and curated details that create a serene yet luxurious atmosphere. Premium finishes are evident throughout, from marble countertops to fitted cabinetry, reflecting an uncompromising commitment to quality. Spacious layouts are designed to harmonize comfort with class, while spectacular views enhance the sense of openness. Every inch of these residences resonates with fine living, making each home a sanctuary of style and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Al Furjan, one of Dubai's most rapidly growing and sought-after communities, this exceptional location offers the perfect blend of peaceful community living and seamless city access. Al Furjan is renowned for its excellent modern infrastructure and outstanding connectivity to the city's major business and leisure centers, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.

The neighborhood is characterized by its vibrant yet tranquil atmosphere, surrounded by thoughtfully designed landscapes and community-centric environments. Residents enjoy effortless access to key destinations, with Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Mall of the Emirates just a short drive away. The area is also conveniently positioned near major roadways and public transportation, including the metro, ensuring smooth connectivity across the city.

For those seeking a residence that offers both serenity and convenience, Al Furjan delivers an unparalleled lifestyle. Its proximity to top-rated schools, shopping destinations, parks, and recreational facilities enhances daily living, while its reputation as a family-friendly community provides a sense of security and belonging. This is a place where modern urban living meets suburban tranquility, an ideal setting for discerning homeowners and investors alike.
